case_number: 2024 INSC 322; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. [NUMBER REDACTED] OF 2024 [Arising out of SLP(Criminal) No. 8922 of 2022] AND CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. [NUMBER REDACTED] OF 2024 [Arising out of SLP(Criminal) No. 3698 of 2023]

parties.respondent: The State of Uttar Pradesh and Another

summary: FIR quashing appeal; insufficient allegations against appellants; mere familial relation to accused officials insufficient; absence of specific role in management or inducement; reliance on Bhajan Lal categories (Category 3); continuation as abuse of process; charge-sheet filing no bar to quashing; impugned HC order rejecting quashing petition set aside.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order refusing to quash FIR set aside; criminal proceedings against appellants quashed
